subject: RFP: sandbox boost request and trial extension for NimbleAI evaluation
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Peter Cohen <peter.cohen@nimbleai.com>
Cc: contracts@nimbleai.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NimbleAI RFP — sandbox boost & short Dedicated pilot proposal

Hi Peter —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We reviewed the RFP and the bake-off timeline. To make sure your team can complete a fair side-by-side evaluation against the incumbent, we'd like to propose two things:

- A sandbox credit top-up of 60,000 token-equivalent credits specifically scoped to the NimbleAI benchmark tests (one-time, non-transferrable).
- A short Dedicated pilot: 2 weeks on a single-node GPU pool (reserved access) to replicate production throughput for your latency-sensitive tests.

We'd also be open to a 30-day trial extension for your engineers if you need more calendar time. The sandbox credits would be tied to the RFP project and this specific evaluation cohort.

If that sounds reasonable, I can route a formal proposal and the procurement details to your contracts team. I attached a one-page proposal with usage assumptions and an example SOW.

Next steps: please confirm the target test dates so we can schedule the Dedicated pilot slot and provision the credits.

Cheers,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0182
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production

Attachments: sandbox-credits-proposal-v2.pdf
From: Peter Cohen <peter.cohen@nimbleai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbleAI RFP — sandbox boost & short Dedicated pilot proposal

Rachel —

Appreciate the fast follow. This is helpful. A few quick clarifications before I loop the procurement folks:

1) Are the credits allowed to be used for synthetic load testing (we'll run head-to-head throughput tests that generate high token volumes)?
2) Does the Dedicated node include KV-cache persistence across restarts for the duration of the pilot? Our benchmark replays rely on stable cache behavior.
3) Pricing/attribution: if we move to purchase post-eval, will historic usage from the sandbox credits be counted toward volume tiers or treated separately? Procurement will ask.

I've attached the section of the RFP that covers evaluation criteria (nimble-rfp.pdf). Target test window is Oct 25–31.

If you can confirm the above, I'll introduce contracts@nimbleai.com to sign the SOW.

Thanks —
Peter
Peter Cohen | Head of ML Ops, NimbleAI
peter.cohen@nimbleai.com

Attachments: nimble-rfp.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: NimbleAI RFP — sandbox boost & short Dedicated pilot proposal

Team — forwarding Peter's RFP excerpt and ask. Key asks: 60k sandbox credits, Dedicated single-node pilot Oct 25–31, KV-cache persistence, and clarity on whether sandbox usage counts toward post-eval tiers.

My recommendation: approve the sandbox top-up but constrain to 45k if legal/finance push back, and offer the 2-week Dedicated pilot with persistent KV-cache enabled. We should make sandbox credits "evaluation-only" (no transfer, no promotional stacking) and state that credits do not count toward purchase volume tiers (they're promotional).

What do you need from me to move to a formal SOW? Also tagging Priyom for any billing rules and Karthik for the capacity reservation/ops side.

--
Rachel
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2026 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: NimbleAI RFP — sandbox boost & short Dedicated pilot proposal

Thanks Rachel — good summary. Approve moving forward with the pilot and credits, with these edits:

- Reduce the sandbox top-up to 45,000 token-equivalent credits (protects promo budget).
- Credits must be explicitly labeled "evaluation-only" and expire 45 days after issuance.
- Credits will NOT be counted toward volume tier calculations for future purchases.
- Legal to add a simple non-solicitation/attribution clause: NimbleAI can't publicly claim Redwood sponsored the bake-off in marketing materials without prior sign-off.

Karthik: please reserve a single-node Dedicated slot for Oct 25–31 with KV-cache persistence enabled and provide an ops contact for the pilot runbook.
Priyom: finance needs the final SOW and promo code mapping (deal DL-2026-1892) to book the credit reserve.

If that approach works, Rachel please send the SOW to contracts@nimbleai.com and cc Legal for the attribution clause.

Ben
Ben Carter | Director, Commercials, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
